info.description:
# SapiSehat — Cattle Disease Classification API

Collection for testing the SapiSehat inference backend.

## Endpoints

| Method | Path          | Description                          |
| ------ | ------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| GET    | /api/health   | Health check + model status          |
| POST   | /api/predict  | Classify cattle disease from image   |

## Environments

- **Local Docker**: `http://localhost:8000`
- **Android Emulator**: `http://10.0.2.2:8000`

## Model Info

- Version: 1.0.0
- Labels: FMD, LSD, healthy
- Confidence threshold: 0.60
- Input size: 224×224

## Response Codes

| Status | Meaning                                      |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| 200    | Success                                      |
| 422    | Invalid image format / empty file / corrupted |
| 500    | Inference error                              |
| 503    | Model not loaded                             |

request.description:
### Health Check

Returns the current health status of the inference service.

**Expected response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "model_version": "1.0.0",
  "model_loaded": true,
  "message": null
}
```

- `status`: `"ok"` when model is loaded, `"degraded"` when model is not loaded
- `model_loaded`: whether the TFLite/keras model is in memory
- `message`: error details when model is not loaded

request.description:
### Predict Cattle Disease

Classifies a cattle image into one of three classes:
- **FMD** — Foot and Mouth Disease (Penyakit Mulut dan Kuku)
- **LSD** — Lumpy Skin Disease
- **healthy** — Healthy cattle (Sapi Sehat)

**Request:**
- Content-Type: `multipart/form-data`
- Field: `image` (file) — JPEG, PNG, or WebP

**Response fields:**
| Field               | Type    | Description                                  |
| ------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| status              | string  | `"success"` or `"error"`                      |
| prediction.label    | string  | Predicted class: FMD / LSD / healthy         |
| prediction.display_label | string | Human-readable label in Indonesian           |
| prediction.confidence | float | Confidence score (0.0 – 1.0)                 |
| prediction.is_reliable | bool | Whether confidence ≥ threshold (0.60)        |
| prediction.scores   | object  | Per-class scores: `{"FMD": 0.85, "LSD": 0.10, "healthy": 0.05}` |
| model_info.version  | string  | Model version                                |
| processing_time_ms  | int     | Total processing time in milliseconds        |
| preprocessing_time_ms | int   | Image preprocessing time (optional)          |
| inference_time_ms   | int     | Model inference time (optional)              |
| message             | string  | Error message (on failure)                   |
